sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: 570 ms after event start, after the lockup has settled; spectrogram shows a short dip then a broadband onset around 24.85 s that fits the music's pulse rather than a chime. No visual change to tie it to.

pattern.description: The previous purple 'Oh hi AI' line blurs away while 'Google' slides in from the left and 'Pixel 9 Pro' from the right with heavy motion blur, both sharpening into a symmetrical lockup flanking the camera bar as the camera pulls back slightly.
pattern.why_premium: Directional motion blur that resolves to crisp type gives speed without a hard cut; mirroring the two words around the camera bar makes the hardware itself the centre of the brand lockup.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.prev-line', {autoAlpha:0, filter:'blur(12px)', duration:0.15, ease:'power1.in'}) .fromTo('.w-google', {x:-120, autoAlpha:0, filter:'blur(16px)'}, {x:0, autoAlpha:1, filter:'blur(0px)', duration:0.35, ease:'expo.out'}, '<0.05') .fromTo('.w-pixel', {x:120, autoAlpha:0, filter:'blur(16px)'}, {x:0, autoAlpha:1, filter:'blur(0px)', duration:0.35, ease:'expo.out'}, '<') .fromTo('.stage', {scale:1.18}, {scale:1, duration:0.8, ease:'power2.out'}, 0).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - 1, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:180, mass:0.8}}); Google translateX = interpolate(p,[0,1],[-120,0]), Pixel translateX = interpolate(p,[0,1],[120,0]); filter blur = interpolate(p,[0,1],[16,0]); opacity = p; stage scale = interpolate(frame,[0,20],[1.18,1],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); no overshoot.

notes: The outgoing 'Oh hi AI' line (visible only in f569) has no box on the end frame, so it is described but not listed as an element. camera.move is pull_out; the phone's apparent shrink is treated as camera, not element motion. Lens-reflection changes in b06/b08 are lighting shifts from the move and are omitted.
